gui.wandscape.info.atm_intro.zh_cn: 游客可通过 ATM 从旅行经费中取现，补充钱包余额。
gui.wandscape.info.atm_intro.en_us: Tourists can withdraw money from the ATM to top up their wallet.

gui.wandscape.info.decoration_intro.zh_cn: 装饰建筑向曼哈顿距离内的功能建筑辐射舒适/魔法/奇观加成，提升其效果。
gui.wandscape.info.decoration_intro.en_us: Decoration buildings radiate Comfort/Magic/Wonder bonuses to nearby functional buildings.
